armySpecialRules.name: BENEATH CONTEMPT
armySpecialRules.description: Gnoblars have the Expendable special rule. In addition, even other Gnoblars treat them as being Expendable.

armySpecialRules.name: BICKER
armySpecialRules.description: Roll a D6 at the beginning of each of your turns for each unit with this special rule that is not in combat or fleeing and has a Unit Strength of 5 or more. If a unit rolls a 1 it may not move in the Movement phase or shoot in the Shooting phase this turn.

armySpecialRules.name: OGRE CHARGE
armySpecialRules.description: Each model on foot with the Ogre Charge special rule that successfully charges an enemy has the Impact Hits (1) special rule. In addition, they add their current Rank Bonus to the Strength of the Impact Hits they inflict. In addition, they count as having one more rank than their actual number for the purpose of determining Steadfast in any turn that they charge.

armySpecialRules.name: BLOOD VULTURE
armySpecialRules.description:
A blood vulture is treated as a missile weapon with the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
24" | 4 | Sniper
Rather than rolling to Hit using Ballistic Skill, the target must pass a Weapon Skill test to avoid being Hit.

armySpecialRules.name: CHAINTRAP
armySpecialRules.description:
A chaintrap has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
6/9" | 6 | Killing Blow, Quick Shot

armySpecialRules.name: GUT-PLATE
armySpecialRules.description: A model with a gut-plate gains a 6+ armour save against attacks to the front.

armySpecialRules.name: IRONFIST
armySpecialRules.description: Buckler. If a model with an ironfist rolls a natural 6 when making a Parry save, it automatically inflicts an extra Hit back onto the model or unit that struck the blow.

armySpecialRules.name: HARPOON LAUNCHER
armySpecialRules.description:
A harpoon launcher has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
28/42" | 5 | Multiple Wounds (D3), Ponderous

armySpecialRules.name: OGRE PISTOL
armySpecialRules.description:
Ogre pistols have the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
12/24" | 5 | Multiple Shots (2)*, Quick Shot
*Requires a brace of Ogre pistols.

armySpecialRules.name: ORIENTAL LONGSWORD
armySpecialRules.description:
Oriental longswords have the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
Combat | As user | Parry (6+)
An Oriental Longsword gives the wielder +1 To Wound.

armySpecialRules.name: LUCK-GNOBLAR
armySpecialRules.description: One use only. An Ogre with a Luck-Gnoblar may re- roll a single armour or invulnerable save, once per battle.

armySpecialRules.name: SWORD-GNOBLAR
armySpecialRules.description: An Ogre with a Sword-Gnoblar benefits from one extra Attack with Weapon Skill 2, Strength 2 and Initiative 2.

armySpecialRules.name: TOOTH-GNOBLAR
armySpecialRules.description: One use only. After attempting to cast a spell from the Lore of the Great Maw, a Butcher with a Tooth- Gnoblar may choose to sacrifice one to get +1 to his casting value.

armySpecialRules.name: LOOK-OUT GNOBLAR
armySpecialRules.description: Any character in a unit with a Look-out Gnoblar benefits from the 'Look Out Sir!' special rule as long as there are three rank and file models of the same troop type remaining in the unit.

armySpecialRules.name: NAME-GNOBLAR
armySpecialRules.description: For each Name-Gnoblar an Ogre has, he can choose an additional Big Name.

armySpecialRules.name: SCALP-GNOBLAR
armySpecialRules.description: One use only. A Butcher with a Scalp-Gnoblar may re- roll a single dice when attempting to cast a spell from the Lore of the Great Maw.

magicItems.name: FROSTFANG
magicItems.description: The bearer gains the Ice Attacks special rule. In addition, at the start of each round of close combat, roll a D6. On a 4+, all attacks made by this weapon are increased by +1 Strength for the duration of the game. This effect is cumulative.

magicItems.name: THUNDERMACE
magicItems.description: The wielder may choose to exchange all of his Attacks in close combat to make a single 'Thundercrush Attack'. Roll To Hit against the highest Weapon Skill amongst the enemy models in base contact. If the Thundercrush Attack hits, place the small template anywhere so that it is touching the wielder's base. Any infantry, war beasts or swarm models that lie underneath the template suffer a single Strength 3 hit. The model under the template's central hole instead suffers a single Strength 9 hit with the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule. This has no effect on other troop types.

magicItems.name: SIEGEBREAKER
magicItems.description: Roll To Hit against the enemy's Initiative instead of his Weapon Skill, and no Parry saves are allowed – it is impossible to deflect a blow from the weapon. In addition, when assaulting models in a building, the wielder can make a 'Siegebreaker Attack' instead of attacking normally in the Close Combat phase. A Siegebreaker Attack inflicts D6 hits with a Strength equal to the height of the building in inches, up to a maximum Strength of 10 (so, for example, models in a building that is 6 inches high would suffer D6 Strength 6 hits). Measure from the base of the building to its highest point.

magicItems.name: THE TENDERISER
magicItems.description: The Tenderiser gives the wielder the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: BLOODCLEAVER
magicItems.description: Every time the wielder causes an unsaved wound with the Bloodcleaver, he may regain one wound he lost earlier in the battle.

magicItems.name: THE FANG OF GHUR
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains the Frenzy special rule. In addition, no Magical Ward saves can be taken against it.

magicItems.name: FROSTSHARD JAVELINS
magicItems.description: Attacks made with this weapon have the Ice Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: SKY-TITAN SCATTER PISTOLS
magicItems.description:
These weapons have the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
9/18" | 5 | Armour Piercing (1), Multiple Shots (2D3), Quick Shot

magicItems.name: BELLOWING BLADE
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon may re-roll one failed To Hit or To Wound roll each round of close combat for every enemy Character within 12".

magicItems.name: BLADE OF ALL-FROST
magicItems.description: For every successful Wound this weapon inflicts on an enemy Character, Monstrous Creature or Monster, that model suffers -1 Strength and Toughness for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: HEADSMASHER
magicItems.description: Headsmasher gives the wielder the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: SPLATTER-CLEAVER
magicItems.description: Every time the wielder causes an unsaved wound with the Splatter- cleaver, they gain +1 Leadership for the duration of the close combat round.

magicItems.name: GREEDY FIST
magicItems.description: The wearer gains +1 Strength and a Magical Ward (6+). If a Magic Weapon inflicts a Wound that is saved by the model's Parry save, it is then treated as a normal, non-magical weapon of the same type for the remainder of the game. In addition, an enemy Wizard loses a Wizard level and a randomly selected spell each time they suffer an unsaved Wound by an Ogre wearing the Greedy Fist.

magicItems.name: MASTODON ARMOUR
magicItems.description: If the wearer is killed by an attack that is not made in close combat, roll a D6; on a 2+, they will remain in play with one Wound remaining.

magicItems.name: GUT MAW
magicItems.description: An Ogre wearing the Gut Maw has the Terror special rule. In addition, he recovers one lost Wound (up to his starting number) for each unsaved Wound he causes in a challenge.

magicItems.name: BULLGUT
magicItems.description: The Bullgut gives the wearer the Impact Hits (D3) special rule, and all Impact Hits have the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: KATTANAK BROWPLATE
magicItems.description: The wearer gains +1 Leadership. In addition, all War Beasts and Monstrous Beasts suffer -1 To Hit against him.

magicItems.name: GREATSKULL
magicItems.description: Any Wizard that targets the bearer with a spell will miscast on any roll of any double.

magicItems.name: GRAWL'S GUT-PLATE
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item and any unit they are with adds +D3" to their charge distance while within 18" of any enemy unit.

magicItems.name: ICE MAMMOTH SKULL PLATE
magicItems.description: The wearer may re-roll failed armour saves.

magicItems.name: SKULLPLUCKER
magicItems.description: Any hits made with the Skullplucker have the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: GNOBLAR THIEFSTONE
magicItems.description:
A Gnoblar Thiefstone grants the bearer Magic Resistance (1). In addition, roll on the following table when the model is deployed to see if the Thiefstone has helped them to 'find' any useful items. Note that this may result in the bearer of the Thiefstone having two or more Talismans. In addition, if a character is killed in close combat while being in base contact with the model wearing the Thiefstone, you will automatically be allowed to pick up any one Magic Item (except Magic Standards) that the slain character might have had, as long as the bearer does not already have a magic item of that type. The model with the Thiefstone may then use that item itself for the rest of the battle.
D6 | Result
1 | Nothing
2 | Lucky Trinket
3 | Talisman of Protection
4 | Crown of Command
5 | The Ruby Ring of Ruin
6 | Talisman of Preservation

magicItems.name: GREYBACK PELT
magicItems.description: The Greyback Pelt gives the bearer the Forest Strider, Hill Strider, Ice Attacks, and Magical Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: SPANGLESHARD
magicItems.description: For each Wound the bearer of the Spangleshard suffers, roll a D6. If this roll is higher than the result of the To Wound roll, that wound is ignored.

magicItems.name: CATHAYAN JET PENDANT
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Cathayan Jet and any unit they join gains the Magic Resistance (3) special rule. This has no effect on spells from the Lore of Yin and Yang.

magicItems.name: THE PELT OF CHARNGAR
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Natural Armour (6+) and Regeneration (5+) special rules.

magicItems.name: THE PURPLE ROCK
magicItems.description: This item may be used once in each enemy Magic phase. When the enemy casts a successful spell, instead of attempting to dispel it the bearer may activate the Purple Rock. Roll a D6, on the result of a 4+ the spell is automatically dispelled. On the result of a 1-3 the spell goes through as normal and the bearer of the Purple Rock suffers a Strength 3 hit.

magicItems.name: THE RIME SHROUD
magicItems.description: All successful To Hit rolls with missile attacks targeting the bearer of this item must be re-rolled.

magicItems.name: RED STONE
magicItems.description: The bearer gains a Magical Ward (6+) and the Magic Resistance (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: BATTERED TALISMAN
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains a Magical Ward (4+) against Attacks with Strength 5 or more.

magicItems.name: FUNNY TRINKET
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may re-roll failed armour saves and invulnerable saves.

magicItems.name: GRUBBI'S DICE BAG
magicItems.description: When the bearer of this item suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On a 2+, the Wound is ignored, as are all subsequent Wounds that turn. On the result of a 1 the bearer is slain outright regardless of the number of Wounds inflicted.

magicItems.name: SHRUNKEN PRIEST HEAD
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains a Magical Ward (5+) against the first wounding Hit each phase.

magicItems.name: WYRDSTONE NECKLACE
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Wyrdstone Necklace gains a Magical Ward (5+). However, they must pass a Toughness test at the start of each of their turns or suffer a wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: HELLHEART
magicItems.description: The Hellheart can be used at the start of one of the opposing side's Magic phases, immediately after rolling for the Winds of Magic. All enemy Wizards within 12" of the bearer must roll 2D6 on the Miscast table. Special rules or magic items that affect a normal miscast roll can be used against miscasts caused by the Hellheart. After resolving all the Miscasts, add an extra dispel dice to the Ogre's dispel pool for each enemy Wizard that was forced to roll on the Miscast table.

magicItems.name: BANGSTICK
magicItems.description: The Bangstick contains a magic missile with a range of 24" that causes 2D6 Strength 4 Hits with the Flaming Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: GRUT'S SICKLE
magicItems.description: At the start of the Ogre Magic phase, the bearer of Grut's Sickle can inflict a single Wound on any unit he has joined. If he does so, then he adds +2 to all casting rolls he makes during that Magic phase. A Wound inflicted by Grut's Sickle is distributed as a shooting attack, and may not be saved in any way. Roll 2D6 at the end of each Magic phase where Grut's Sickle is used; on a roll of 3 or more nothing happens, but on a roll of double 1 the unit turns upon and slays the wielder of Grut's Sickle, and he is removed as a casualty with no saves of any kind allowed.

magicItems.name: THE HUNGRY MAW
magicItems.description: The Hungry Maw can be used after successfully dispelling an enemy spell. When used, the enemy caster can no longer use this spell for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: HALFLING COOKBOOK
magicItems.description: A model with the Halfling Cookbook may re-roll one dice (except 1's) per casting roll when using the Lore of the Great Maw.

magicItems.name: DRAGON HEART
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any of your Magic phases. For the duration of this turn, the bearer may re-roll failed casting attempts.

magicItems.name: FLASK OF CONGEALED MAW-JUICES
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any of your Magic phases. For the duration of this turn, you may add one free power dice to each of the model's casting attempts.

magicItems.name: BLOODROCK TALISMAN
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains a +2 dispel bonus if they are within 12" of the casting Wizard.

magicItems.name: WIZARDFLESH APRON
magicItems.description: At the start of each of your Magic phases, the bearer of this item can pick one additional spell from the Lore of the Great Maw of those normally available to them and cast it this turn.
magicItems.restriction: Wizard with the Lore of the Great Maw

magicItems.name: TOKENS OF THE EVERWINTER
magicItems.description: This can be used at the start of any round of close combat. For the duration of this turn, the model (but not any mount) gains +1 Strength as well as the Always Strikes First and Natural Armour (5+) special rules.

magicItems.name: BRAND OF THE SVARD
magicItems.description: The bearer's mount gain +1 To Hit in close combat.

magicItems.name: THE SEAT OF ALVAGR
magicItems.description: The model may make double their normal amount of Stomps.

magicItems.name: BLEEDING SKULL OF DRAGAAR
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item can channel dispel dice in the same manner as a Level 2 Wizard.

magicItems.name: GNOBLAR BLAST KEG
magicItems.description: This item can be used during any of your Shooting phases. Place the small round template anywhere within 6" – it scatters D3". Any model touched by the template suffers a Strength 3 Hit with the Armour Piercing (1) special rule. The model under the hole suffers a Strength 6 Hit with the Armour Piercing (1) and Multiple Wounds (D3) special rules.

magicItems.name: GRUESOME TROPHY RACK
magicItems.description: Any unit joined by this model may re-roll 1's To Hit in close combat.

magicItems.name: SHATTERSTONE
magicItems.description: All enemy units within 12" of the bearer of this item treat all terrain features as Dangerous Terrain. Terrain that is already Dangerous Terrain makes them fail the test on a 1-2 instead of just a 1.

magicItems.name: BRAHMIR STATUE
magicItems.description: Any Psychology tests caused by the bearer of the Brahmir Statue (or any unit they are with) on any Beastmen unit are taken with a -3 Leadership penalty.

magicItems.name: ALVAGR RUNE-TOKENS
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any round of close combat. The wielder gains the Ice Attacks special rule for the duration of this round.

magicItems.name: CARVALOX FLANK
magicItems.description: All friendly units of Yhetees within 12" of the bearer gain +2 to their Movement.

magicItems.name: ELIXIR OF THE FROSTWYRM
magicItems.description: The bearer gains a Strength 4 Breath Weapon attack with the Ice Attacks special rule. However, after using it they will automatically suffer a Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: FROST-TALON SHARDBOLTS
magicItems.description: All shots fired by their weapon have the Ice Attacks and Magical Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: GREASE-SMEARED TUSKS
magicItems.description: All friendly Monstrous Beasts, Monstrous Creatures and Monsters within 12" gain +1 to their Movement.

magicItems.name: JADE LION
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Jade Lion and any unit they are with may re-roll any failed Psychology tests. If the unit flees for any reason, this benefit is lost for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: BATTLE BREW
magicItems.description: The bearer may use this item at the start of any of your turns. If they do so, they gain +1 To Hit and To Wound in Close Combat this turn. However, at the end of that round of close combat (before break tests are taken), they must pass a Toughness test or suffer a Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: FLASK OF STONEHORN BLOOD
magicItems.description: The bearer may use this item at the start of any of your turns. If they do so, all attacks targeting them must re-roll successful rolls To Wound for the duration of this turn.

magicItems.name: OGRE TOOTH
magicItems.description: This item may be used at the start of any of your turns. Roll a D6; on the result of a 1 the bearer is immediately removed as a casualty. On the result of a 2+, the character and any Gnoblar unit within 6" gains the Immunity (Psychology) special rule until the start of your next turn.

magicItems.name: SKULLMANTLE
magicItems.description: Any enemy unit forced to take any Leadership tests due to the bearer or a unit they have joined suffers a -1 penalty to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: FISTFUL OF LAURELS
magicItems.description: The model with the Fistful of Laurels and any unit they are with may re-roll their first failed Break test in the game using an additional D6 and discard the highest result.

magicItems.name: ROCK EYE
magicItems.description: At the beginning of each Ogre turn, pick one unit in the line of sight of the bearer of the Rock Eye. The opposing player must announce the presence of all Magic Items, Hidden models and the like that unit might have.

magicItems.name: DRAGONHIDE BANNER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard can re-roll all To Hit, To Wound and saving throw rolls of 1 on the turn they make a successful charge. In addition, the bearer of the banner can use it to unleash an icy blast. This is a Strength 3 Breath Weapon with the Ice Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE GREAT MAW
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: CANNIBAL TOTEM
magicItems.description: If the unit carrying this standard is in base contact with an enemy Troop Type with the same or higher Unit Strength as them, all models in the unit re-roll failed To Hit and To Wound rolls in the first round of that combat. However, they may not Overrun and must Pursue the enemy if possible.

magicItems.name: RUNE MAW
magicItems.description: When any enemy spell targeting a unit with this standard is successfully cast, roll a D6. On a roll of 2+, the caster must choose a new target for the spell. If no other target is available (because no other target is in range or all eligible units have already been targeted, for example), then the spell is wasted but still counts as having been cast. Spells that do not specifically target the unit are not affected by the Rune Maw.

magicItems.name: BULL STANDARD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard re-rolls failed To Wound rolls for their Impact Hits.

magicItems.name: RAGBANNER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard has the Cold-blooded special rule when taking Panic tests.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF THE GREAT MAW
loresOfMagic.attribute: Roll a D6 immediately after resolving the effects of a successfully cast spell from the Lore of the Great Maw. On a roll of 2-6, the Wizard that cast the spell recovers one lost Wound (up to his starting number of Wounds), and adds +1 to the total rolled on the dice the next time he attempts to cast or dispel a spell. On a roll of 1 the Wizard that cast the spell suffers a Strength 6 hit.

spells.name: SPINEMARROW
spells.description: Spinemarrow is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target has the Stubborn special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: BILEBREW
spells.description: Bilebrew is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains the Hatred special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: BLOOD FEAST
spells.description: Blood Feast is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains the Frenzy special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: BULLGORGER
spells.description: Bullgorger is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains +1 Strength until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: BONECRUSHER
spells.description: Bonecrusher is a magic missile with a range of 18" that causes 2D6 Strength 2 hits which Ignores Armour Saves.

spells.name: BRAINGOBBLER
spells.description: Braingobbler is a hex spell with a range of 18". The target must take a Panic test. If the test is passed, the unit gains the Stupidity special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: GREASY DELUGE
spells.description: Greasy Deluge is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target suffer -1 To Hit in close combat and with missile weapons until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: ROCKCHOMPER
spells.description: Rockchomper is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains the Armour Piercing (1) and Killing Blow special rules until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: TOOTHCRACKER
spells.description: Toothcracker is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains +1 Toughness until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: FEAST OF THE FALLEN
spells.description: Remains in play. Feast of the Fallen is an augment spell with a range of 18" that targets Monstrous Infantry. While the spell is in effect, at the end of each round of close combat (before break tests are taken), the target unit regains a Wound suffered earlier during the game for every unsaved Wound they caused in close combat. Wounds are restored in the same manner as a summoning spell.

spells.name: VORACIOUS MAW
spells.description: Voracious Maw is a summoning area spell with a range of 24" that uses the large round template (it does not scatter). The template is considered Dangerous Terrain for all models, except that all tests fail on a 1-2 rather than a 1. If the Voracious Maw inflicts five or more unsaved Wounds in a single phase, or the spell is successfully cast again, the spell ends and the template is removed.

spells.name: TROLLGUTS
spells.description: Trollguts is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target has the Regeneration (4+) special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: THE GREAT MAW AWAKENS
spells.description: Remains in play. The Great Maw Awakens is a magical vortex that uses the small round template. Any model touched by the template at any point during its move must take an Initiative test. Models that pass the test suffer a Strength 3 hit. Models that fail the test suffer a Strength 7 hit with the Multiple Wounds (D6) special rule.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: DEATHCHEATER
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: Starting from the end of the phase in which the character is down to their last Wound, they receive a 3+ invulnerable save.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: MOUNTAINEATER
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: The character will never be wounded on a score better than a 3+. Hits that cause automatic Wounds are unaffected.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: KINEATER
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: Any friendly unit within 12" of the character may re-roll failed Panic tests.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: BEASTKILLER
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: When making attacks against War Beasts, Monstrous Beasts, Monstrous Creatures or Monsters, the character gains +1 on his rolls To Wound. If the character is using a magic weapon, then he does not get this bonus.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: GIANTBREAKER
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: The character gains +1 Strength. They may never refuse challenges, and neither they nor a unit they are with may choose to flee as a charge reaction.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: GUTSLUGGER
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: The character gains +1 To Hit in close combat in any turn in which it did not charge.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: MAWSEEKER
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: The character gains +1 Toughness and the Stupidity special rule.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: BRAWLERGUTS
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: The character gains the Impact Hits (D3) special rule.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: NECKWRINGER
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: Enemy Infantry in combat with this character cannot claim the bonus for Outnumbering their foe.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: WALLCRUSHER
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: The character does one additional Impact Hit on a successful Ogre Charge. In addition, they ignore all the effects of obstacles when attacking units that are defending them.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: MAGESWALLOWER
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: The character gains the Magical Attacks special rule.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: MONSTERWRESTLER
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: Monstrous Creatures and Monsters cannot use Stomp against this character or their unit.

big_names_of_the_ogres.name: STEEDEATER
big_names_of_the_ogres.description: The character and any unit they are with gain the Swiftstride special rule when charging or pureeing enemy War Beasts and Cavalry.
